caption: The drawing features a circular design with a brown border, containing five stylized plant stems, each ending in elongated, red-brown leaves that are grouped in clusters. The background within the circle is a warm yellowish-brown, with irregular green patches scattered throughout. Near the center of the circle, two sets of inscriptions are visible: "1832" is written in a slanted manner above the middle-left plant stem, and "J+H" appears toward the lower center, between two stems. All plant stems converge at a rectangular green base at the bottom center of the circle. The drawing is set against an off-white background.
